mia_cs: Day0 sync for Quantum Exchange private deployment. Short checklist: network CIDR sanity, transit peering vs TGW, IAM mapping (SSO), KMS ownership, audit delivery to Splunk. Any major red flags? cc @sam_infra @devon_se @harper_sec
sam_infra: Quick network note  customer suggested 172.20.0.0/16. That collides with one of our partner backbones in us-east. Asked them to pick a /20 or a different /16 (prefer non-172 range). Also need to decide on TGW attachment vs VPC peering for their account (scale + cross-region wins TGW).
mia_cs: They can move to 10.250.0.0/20 if that helps. They prefer TGW for multi-region routing.
devon_se: IAM plan: we'll provision a cross-account role per service (not a single omnibus role). SAML provisioning via their Okta tenant for humans; service roles use sts:AssumeRole with ExternalId. Draft trust-policy link posted in runbook.

devon_se: Example minimal trust snippet:
```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::999888777666:role/redwood-service"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRole","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"sts:ExternalId":"quantum-ex-2026"}}}]}
```
harper_sec: KMS: they requested BYOK (import key material). Security notes:
- BYOK is supported but we require key rotation policy and proof of HSM origin
- Key policy must include explicit usage controls (GenerateDataKey, Decrypt) scoped to the Redwood service principal and their log delivery role only
- We recommend 180-day rotation for customer-imported keys; native AWS KMS customers can do 90 days.

harper_sec: Also need to confirm whether they want key replication (multi-region keys) or single-region master (we default single-region).
audit-bot: Audit delivery guidance: best practice is S3 bucket in their account with BlockPublicAcls=true, Object Ownership = bucket-owner-enforced, SSE-KMS with the KMS key ARN (or AES256 if they prefer). Delivery role needs s3:PutObject and s3:PutObjectAcl. Consider S3 Event notifications to a Splunk ingest lambda if direct forwarding is used. Docs: https://redwood.docs/onboard/audit-s3-forwarding
sam_infra: Egress and endpoints: we'll create a VPC endpoint for S3 and a NAT Gateway for external OS updates. If they want Splunk forwarder outbound, recommend a specific egress SG and allowlist. Also enabling VPC Flow Logs to our central logging account required.
mia_cs: Renewal risk note: customer success flagged that the pilot SLA (99.9 latency) is tied to first-week go-live. If network or KMS BYOK provisioning delays >7 business days, escalate renewal risk to 'at-risk'. Logging this in customer tracker. :warning:
devon_se: Action items summary: [1] harper_sec 14 confirm BYOK policy + rotation window; [2] sam_infra 14 plan TGW attachments + PR for route tables and endpoints; [3] mia_cs 14 obtain final S3 bucket name and confirm SSE settings with customer. I'll add owners in the runbook.
harper_sec: I'll post the suggested KMS policy snippet and BYOK acceptance checklist in the runbook by EOD.
sam_infra: Opening infra PR for TGW and NAT now: https://github.com/redwood/infracluster/pull/1499 will include Flow Log config and endpoint defs.
mia_cs: Target to close these open items: 72 hours. If we hit any external gating (legal on BYOK), I'll escalate to AE and include renewal-risk tag.
audit-bot: Reminder to include S3 lifecycle + retention policy in onboarding checklist (retain logs for minimum 365 days unless otherwise agreed).
mia_cs: Fantastic, thanks everyone 44D I'll update the shared runbook and ping when customer confirms bucket + okta mapping.
